programmes.description: While trying to save her show and pitching an idea to another, a renowned broadcaster is accused of murder. programmes.title: Bahar
programmes.description: After surviving a serious illness, Bahar, a devoted wife, finds herself facing a series of personal setbacks. With her marriage falling apart, she chooses to reclaim control of her life by returning to the medical career she once left behind.
